newsitem.title: BELGIUM: Three bodies found in Brussels restaurant freezer.
newsitem.headline: Three bodies found in Brussels restaurant freezer.

text.p: The bodies of two women and parts of a third body were found in the deep freeze of a Brussels restaurant on Tuesday, Belgian news agency Belga reported, citing judicial sources.
There were signs that a violent struggle had taken place in the restaurant, which is in the heart of Brussels' diplomatic district and which specialised in Lebanese cooking.

Police were said to be searching for the restaurant's owner, who was last seen in the middle of August, Belga said. A local police spokesman told Reuters officers were at the scene and he was unable to comment further.
